scope: Forward closure of known specification/integration gaps against the existing launch contract; not a claim that every unknown defect is found or runtime is complete.

status_vocabulary.selected_design: Behavior deliberately chosen for forward implementation; numeric tuning/native assets/runtime remain unproved.
status_vocabulary.existing_contract: Requirement already existed; this audit links its cross-system evidence rather than inventing a missing feature.
status_vocabulary.source_gap: Missing source stays unresolved and cannot pass by prose.

game_fit_tests: Strengthens the move/work/carry/deliver/transform/rescue/defend loop or necessary reliability/accessibility.
Uses simple contextual controls and visible, understandable outcomes.
Preserves a realistic free route and meaningful earned resource purpose.
Uses credible species/environment behavior and selected GitHub art.
Fits measured mobile CPU/GPU/memory and sustained performance requirements.
Does not import explicit post-launch features or new mandatory currency/maintenance systems.

decisions.title: Readable danger with protected earned progress
decisions.selected_behavior: Normal play protects owned inventory, earned cash, purchased items, levels, plots, rescued identities and pet upgrades. The permanent camp interior is a sanctuary. Outside it, enemies can hurt field actors and interrupt gathering, deliveries and exposed forward production. A disabled forward machine or route pauses its service until a free player/worker repair interaction completes; no plot de-level, stored-stock destruction, repair invoice, or loss while absent. The player avoids being driven back, an interrupted expedition, temporarily unavailable companions, and interrupted exposed operations. Threats are visibly warned and recoverable. Leaving a known encounter resets its unearned enemy progress; no kill/loot reward comes from a reset. First-time construction or reconstruction of an unowned derelict site has its declared project bill; repairing damage to an already owned working site does not charge materials or cash. Sanctuary interior actors cannot attack out while immune. A perimeter defense is eligible to engage its declared outside approach only within the exposed defense rules; customers wait safely when routes are disrupted.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Enemy health/damage/cadence, warning windows and repair duration require owner tuning and repeated-failure playtests.
Prove safe-boundary crossing, return routes and no safe-zone reward farming.

decisions.title: Player, pet and survivor recovery
decisions.selected_behavior: At zero health the player returns to the last restored safe camp, or the guaranteed safe arrival anchor before any camp is restored, at full current health with controls/camera restored and owned cargo/progression intact. Pets and survivors outside sanctuary visibly retreat when possible; if downed they are evacuated to that camp and temporarily unavailable for their task. A short free care interaction by the player or an available survivor restores them; if all helpers are unavailable the player can always perform it. No permanent death, roster deletion, paid revive, compulsory medicine, hunger, stamina, cold or oxygen meter. Preserve typed cargo in that actor's recovery custody and return it exactly once; do not duplicate it into world drops. Suspended jobs release transient reservations and revalidate after care.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Freeze non-punitive care time/health tuning and actor-specific retreat/evacuation presentation.
Test all actors down, repeated failure, care interruption, reserved payment and full destination.

decisions.title: Survivors share the player's logical carrying policy
decisions.selected_behavior: Every survivor uses unlimited logical mixed inventory, matching the player. Visible stacks are aggregated representations with truthful quantities; rendered mesh count is never cargo capacity. An authorized job reserves a bounded bill/target quantity and duration, so unlimited capacity cannot create infinite harvesting, overbuying or never-ending trips. All survivors can perform all ordinary physical task families with reachable suitable equipment; specialization changes preference/efficiency and never blocks baseline competence. Include every plot family, conveyors included, and ordinary earned-cash purchases. No autonomous premium, real-money or entitlement purchase.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Demonstrate early/middle/late mixed-load throughput and large-count storage/save behavior.
Tune trip batch amounts, transfer cadence and optional efficiency upgrades without reducing logical capacity.

decisions.title: Owned pets, active expedition and useful reserve
decisions.selected_behavior: All seven pets are permanent ownable companions and all seven attack. Select up to three pets for a field expedition; reserve pets receive useful eligible safe-camp/local assignments and retain combat roles in suitable areas. When no eligible safe job exists, a truthful ready/rest state is valid; guarding an invulnerable empty interior does not count as a completed useful job. Select up to two survivors as field escorts from the working population; this expedition limit does not cap separately assigned local workers. Camp survivors remain useful in their assigned jobs; no device-specific logical worker cap or paid active slot is introduced. Switching at a safe camp is free and first settles cargo/jobs; injury, attack recovery and cooldown state persist, so switching cannot heal or reset attacks. Offscreen active-session work uses the same conserved job ledger; unseen combat never fabricates kills or loot. All owned workers are represented by the authored rescue/content roster, rather than unlimited procedural spawning.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Three pets/two escorts are initial authored design limits, not measured performance claims; prove the exact busy-scene population.
T31/T56 must bind the actual authored per-region survivor census and test every active assignment, including offscreen-to-visible handoff.

decisions.title: Simple goals and useful autonomous decisions
decisions.selected_behavior: Use one contextual goal/assignment choice, one recall/return choice and optional priority selection. Default priority is explicit recall/safety, immediate threat to the protected actor/area, authorized selected hostile, assigned defense/hunt, then safe opportunistic attack. Keep valid work/targets stable, reserve approach space and resources, and release stale claims. Worker spending is limited to an approved goal, ordinary resource/cash budget and protected reserve; changed price or revoked budget stops before the next debit with a clear reason. T07 remains the frozen human-context selector; pet/job arbitration belongs to the species/T31 owners and does not silently extend T07 scope.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Test blocked route, depletion, full storage, budget revocation, simultaneous last plot payment, recall and resumption with bounded retry.
Measure decision cost and useful job completion; navigation avoidance alone is not intelligence.

decisions.title: Bounded combat roster and contextual weapon progression
decisions.selected_behavior: The selected core combat families are a pursuing hostile wolf, a close raider, a visibly telegraphed heavy ice brute, a ranged rival rifleman, a lane-pressure hooded swarmer and a hooded siege boss that combines readable established threats. Use their existing selected GitHub sheets. These six define the launch behavioral roster; regional art variants must keep explicit identity/source and habitat compatibility, not make a polar animal live in lava. Select the Tundra Stag as the authored hunt source and preserve current hostile-wolf meat drops; owned pets are never prey. Boar and other additional wildlife concepts remain reserve. Other enemy and meat render concepts remain preserved reserve, not mandatory encounters or currencies. Player weapons have two contextual families: the existing axe for close work/defense and an authored spear for longer-reach defense, earned at the Level9 defense goal. Free earned-material tiers improve each; no action bar, compulsory ammo wallet or paid-only counter. The axe sheet is direct reference; the existing spear-raider gear sheet is a proportion starting point, not an approved player rig or motion.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Bind exact hostile/hunt IDs, habitats, unlock rows, HP/damage, contact profiles and useful counterplay.
Create and review any missing player spear and regional variant native assets against the selected references; no static render grants animation approval.
Every biome uses only habitat-appropriate selected encounters or explicitly reviewed variants; new archetypes require a scoped decision rather than automatic concept activation.

decisions.title: Physical regional continuity
decisions.selected_behavior: Keep the same move, gather, visibly carry, deliver, transform, rescue and defend loop across ten connected regions. Underwater work uses protected dry habitats/tunnels and authored accessible work sites; the owl remains on suitable air routes/staging. Sky play uses walkable connected platforms/bridges; quadrupeds do not fly. Volcanic and swamp areas use restored safe lanes and appropriate reachable work surfaces. Every species retains useful combat in applicable regions and useful safe work when a region is unsuitable. Travel preserves identity/cargo/jobs and offers a free return to the last safe restored camp. Regional art never implies a new oxygen/heat/poison maintenance meter. Playable underwater travel and work remain on dry protected routes/positions; appropriate gear reaches salvage without mandatory swimming. Each earlier region owner implements its own local arrival/return contract before its integration; T53 later integrates shared transport and is not an added backward prerequisite.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Prove actual routes, terrain contact, target reach, transport and no stranding in each region.
The regional outcome matrix selects content; missing native assets and motion remain unproved.

decisions.title: Material, money and concept identity
decisions.selected_behavior: Adopt the dated progression/economy value-chain decisions as the forward selected design. Coal is an earned physical fuel input, metal is ore feedstock, and steel is a processed material; slate, planks and blocks have named construction uses. Existing money is the single ordinary earned currency regardless of till/pocket/house custody. Use Gems as the display name for the one primary premium currency, canonical premium_gems, with explicit migration if an existing selected runtime wallet uses another ID; do not create a second wallet. XP is progression and VIP is a permanent entitlement. Launch events grant existing resources, money and explicit rewards; no event token wallet. Rendered containers and meat variants do not automatically create new inventory/currency IDs. Unselected concepts remain preserved reserve.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Bind recipe quantities, prices, rates, identifiers and migration to actual producer code before integration.
Run free-player reachable progression, surplus/shortage and conversion-cycle tests; no claims of numeric balance from this plan.

decisions.title: Played time, server time and absence
decisions.selected_behavior: Launch ordinary world simulation pauses when the app backgrounds or closes. Resume the saved state without absence damage, missing cargo or invented offline income. Offscreen work may continue only while the game is active and the same authoritative job ledger advances. Local played time governs ordinary machine/actor animation and recovery. Server time governs live event availability, purchases and entitlements; changing the device clock never creates rewards or extends an event. Core ordinary play and recovery remain usable offline; server-only grants/purchases stay visibly pending or unavailable until verified. No speculative reward replay on reconnect. Launch event objective participation requires verified connection. While offline, the event clearly pauses objective credit and consumes no event-specific inputs; ordinary core activities continue. Until a server completion receipt exists the UI says pending, never earned. A server-verified completion before expiry creates a durable earned claim that remains deliverable after expiry; a lost response or reconnect grants it exactly once. An uncompleted expired objective grants nothing.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Test background/kill at every pre/post-commit boundary, older save migration, account change and cloud conflict.
Event end while absent must preserve committed rewards and reject unearned expired rewards.

decisions.title: Landscape and distinct device layouts
decisions.selected_behavior: Retain the requested landscape game. Shipping configuration supports both landscape rotations and must not expose unsupported portrait gameplay. Godot SCREEN_SENSOR_LANDSCAPE=4 is the baseline setting; platform export/orientation settings must agree. The observed current source uses orientation6 and needs owner implementation reconciliation. Correct the phone16:9 logical test fixture to1920x1080; keep the separate20:9 fixture2400x1080. Test fold/unfold, safe areas, suspended input and restored state in supported landscape layouts. Layout dimensions are not native4K performance evidence.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Physical phone/tablet/foldable tests and the actual shipping orientation/export configuration remain unproved.
T68/T69 retain exact-source sustained native>=3840x2160 and>=60FPS certification.

decisions.title: A complete Level100 ending within launch scope
decisions.selected_behavior: Author one useful outcome for each Level1–100 within the existing ten bands. Level100 completes the restored connected camp/route network, shows an earned conclusion/celebration and lets the player continue existing production, exploration and launch events. Do not add Level101, new regions, a new mastery-contract system, decoration, co-op or additional Level100 activity families as1.0 blockers. Prior T12 structural role IDs and T10/T11 binding receipts remain intact; new outcome rows are content decisions, not activation or proof.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Freeze attainable costs/rewards and pacing with first-time and returning free-player sessions.
Prove an uninterrupted complete route and persistent final state.

decisions.title: Fair launch events, commerce and diagnostics
decisions.selected_behavior: Keep the existing FirstThaw/weekly/seasonal frameworks and pre-approved components. Events are optional and cannot be required to repair a base-game shortage or recover a companion. Reject schedules with unavailable resources, locations, companions or time; use server-time expiry, exactly-once grants, kill switch and rollback. Preserve permanent transparent VIP, advertised purchase value, verified restoration and a realistic$0 Level1–100 route. Challenge difficulty never reads spending. Diagnostics observe stuck jobs, missing transfers, save conflicts and performance without becoming gameplay authority or collecting unnecessary personal information. Earned but unclaimed event rewards survive expiry when a completion receipt was committed before expiry. Network interruption between that receipt and grant is resolved by the same durable claim key, not by current event visibility.
remaining_evidence_or_tuning: Run actual purchase restore/refund/reconnect, expired events, disabled server components, diagnostics failure and privacy/security cases.
Validation-only owners route repairs to implementing tasks; they do not build fixes during release certification.
